title: Signs of the End of the Age

questions.question: As Jesus came out of the temple, one of His disciples pointed out the wonderful stones and buildings. What did Jesus prophesy about these buildings?
options: "There will not be left here one stone upon another that will not be thrown down."
"These very stones will cry out in praise of the Lord on the last day."
"They will stand forever as a testimony to Israel."
"The Romans will cover these stones in gold before the end."
questions.correctAnswer: "There will not be left here one stone upon another that will not be thrown down."
questions.explanation: Mark 13:2 (ESV): "And Jesus said to him, 'Do you see these great buildings? There will not be left here one stone upon another that will not be thrown down.'"

questions.question: Which four disciples asked Jesus privately: "Tell us, when will these things be, and what will be the sign when all these things are about to be accomplished?"
options: Peter, James, John, and Andrew
Peter, James, John, and Judas
Matthew, Thomas, Philip, and Bartholomew
Simon, Thaddaeus, James the Less, and Matthew
questions.explanation: Mark 13:3-4 (ESV): "And as he sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately, 'Tell us, when will these things be...'"

questions.question: Jesus warned them that many will come in His name saying, "I am he!", and what will they do?
options: They will lead many astray
They will start terrible wars
They will heal the sick falsely
他们将自称为罗马皇帝
questions.explanation: Mark 13:6 (ESV): "Many will come in my name, saying, 'I am he!' and they will lead many astray."

questions.question: When they hear of wars and rumors of wars, Jesus said they should not be alarmed; this must take place, but it is not yet the end. He compared these events (earthquakes, famines) to what?
options: The beginning of the birth pains
The closing of a book
The final harvest before winter
The thunder before the rain
questions.correctAnswer: The beginning of the birth pains
questions.explanation: Mark 13:8 (ESV): "...There will be earthquakes in various places; there will be famines. These are but the beginning of the birth pains."

questions.question: Jesus said the disciples would be delivered over to councils and beaten in synagogues to bear witness before governors and kings. Furthermore, "the gospel must first be..." what?
options: "...preached to all nations."
"...believed by the whole house of Israel."
"...hidden from those who seek to destroy it."
"...written down by prophets."
questions.explanation: Mark 13:10 (ESV): "And the gospel must first be preached to all nations."

questions.question: When they are delivered over to authorities, they should not be anxious beforehand what they are to say. Who will give them the words to speak?
options: The Holy Spirit
The Father in heaven
Angels carrying a scroll
Their own trained intellect
questions.explanation: Mark 13:11 (ESV): "...for it is not you who speak, but the Holy Spirit."

questions.question: Jesus warned that "brother will deliver brother over to death, and the father his child, and children will rise against parents." What did He say about the one who endures to the end?
options: "But the one who endures to the end will be saved."
"Will be granted a crown of martyrdom."
"Will lead the armies of heaven."
"But the one who endures to the end will receive double portion."
questions.correctAnswer: "But the one who endures to the end will be saved."
questions.explanation: Mark 13:13 (ESV): "And you will be hated by all for my name's sake. But the one who endures to the end will be saved."

questions.question: When they see the "abomination of desolation standing where he ought not to be," what should those in Judea do?
options: Flee to the mountains
Hide in the temple cellars
Stay and fight bravely
Cross the sea to safety
questions.explanation: Mark 13:14 (ESV): "But when you see the abomination of desolation standing where he ought not to be... then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains."

questions.question: In those days, what sort of tribulation will happen?
options: Tribulation such as has not been from the beginning of the creation that God created until now, and never will be
A plague of locusts matching the plagues of Egypt
The waters turning fully to blood for seven days
A localized famine lasting nearly ten years
questions.correctAnswer: Tribulation such as has not been from the beginning of the creation that God created until now, and never will be
questions.explanation: Mark 13:19 (ESV): "For in those days there will be such tribulation as has not been from the beginning of the creation that God created until now, and never will be."

questions.question: Why did the Lord cut short the days of tribulation?
options: For the sake of the elect, whom he chose
Because the angels pleaded with him to stop
To preserve the holy temple stones
Before humanity was entirely wiped out entirely
questions.correctAnswer: For the sake of the elect, whom he chose
questions.explanation: Mark 13:20 (ESV): "And if the Lord had not cut short the days, no human being would be saved. But for the sake of the elect, whom he chose, he shortened the days."

questions.question: After that tribulation, what will happen to the sun, moon, and stars?
options: The sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, and the stars will be falling from heaven
The sun will be as blood, the moon will shatter, and the stars will burn the earth
They will remain unchanged, masking the terror on earth
A new sun will replace the old sun in the sky
questions.correctAnswer: The sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, and the stars will be falling from heaven
questions.explanation: Mark 13:24-25 (ESV): "But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light, and the stars will be falling from heaven..."

questions.question: How will they finally see the Son of Man coming?
options: In clouds with great power and glory
Hidden amongst a great multitude
As a thief stealing through the night
Walking down from the highest mountain peak
questions.correctAnswer: In clouds with great power and glory
questions.explanation: Mark 13:26 (ESV): "And then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory."

questions.question: From the parable of the fig tree, when its branch becomes tender and puts out its leaves, what do you know is near?
options: Summer is near
Winter is near
The great wind is near
The harvest is already past
questions.explanation: Mark 13:28 (ESV): "From the fig tree learn its lesson: as soon as its branch becomes tender and puts out its leaves, you know that summer is near."

questions.question: Who knows the exact day or hour of these events?
options: No one, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father
Only Jesus and the Father
A few selected prophets who read the signs accurately
No one, not even God has decided yet
questions.correctAnswer: No one, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father
questions.explanation: Mark 13:32 (ESV): "But concerning that day or that hour, no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father."

questions.question: What is the final command Jesus gives at the end of Chapter 13 regarding the unknown time of His return?
options: "Stay awake."
"Hide yourselves."
"Flee the city."
"Gather your wealth."
questions.explanation: Mark 13:37 (ESV): "And what I say to you I say to all: Stay awake."

key_verse_text: "Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away."
